name: astro-tailwind-starter
description: Minimal Astro v6 starter kit with Tailwind CSS v4, TypeScript, Prettier, and ESLint pre-configured. Ready to deploy on Cloudflare Workers.

paragraphs: This is a starter kit pre-configured with Astro v6 + Tailwind CSS v4 + Prettier + ESLint. It eliminates the initial environment setup, allowing you to focus immediately on design and development.
features: Contains no specific themes. However, Tailwind Typography is included for styled prose content, ensuring basic default styling without extra configuration.
Pre-configured with Prettier and ESLint. Automatically maintains code quality and accessibility standards.
Uses mostly default settings. No complex custom rules; follows the official documentation.
Includes only the essential configuration required to start development. Minimal setup time, ready to code.

whatItDoes.text: This is a starter kit pre-configured with Astro v6 + Tailwind CSS v4 + Prettier + ESLint. It eliminates the initial environment setup, allowing you to focus immediately on design and development.
